items.instruction: Compute the total number of orders placed per calendar month.
items.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS m, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

items.instruction: List every active customer with their most recent login timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT customer_id, MAX(login_at) FROM logins GROUP BY customer_id

items.instruction: Find the average order value for each shipping region.
items.sql: SELECT region, AVG(amount) FROM orders JOIN regions USING (region_id) GROUP BY region

items.instruction: Return products whose total sold quantity exceeds one hundred units.
items.sql: SELECT product_id FROM sales GROUP BY product_id HAVING SUM(quantity) > 100

items.instruction: Show the top three salespeople by closed revenue.
items.sql: SELECT salesperson_id, SUM(revenue) FROM deals GROUP BY salesperson_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

items.instruction: Count distinct visitors per landing page for the last quarter.
items.sql: SELECT page_id, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) FROM page_views GROUP BY page_id

items.instruction: Determine which employees have never submitted an expense report.
items.sql: SELECT employee_id FROM employees WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expenses WHERE expenses.employee_id = employees.employee_id)

items.instruction: Compute the running total of payments per account ordered by date.
items.sql: SELECT account_id, paid_on, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY paid_on) FROM payments

items.instruction: Join customers, orders, and line items to report revenue per category.
items.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, p.category, SUM(li.quantity * p.price) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN line_items li ON li.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = li.product_id GROUP BY 1, 2

items.instruction: Report the number of support tickets reopened after resolution.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_events a JOIN ticket_events b ON a.ticket_id = b.ticket_id AND b.event_time > a.event_time WHERE a.state = 'resolved' AND b.state = 'reopened'
